description: Test fixture demonstrating confusing 'Swap (+)' and 'Swap (-)' protection string values
scenario: getPickOptions() includes 'Swap (+)' and 'Swap (-)' as protection dropdown options, but swap is NOT protection
phase4Finding: These options should be REMOVED from protection dropdown - swap is a separate pick property

whereUsed.uiDropdown: TradePickRow.jsx:127 - renders all getPickOptions() values in protection dropdown

riskAssessment.evidence: isMeaningfulProtection() regex does not match 'Swap (+)' or 'Swap (-)'
riskAssessment.stepienBehavior: Picks with protection='Swap (+)' are treated as UNPROTECTED by Stepien
riskAssessment.userConfusion: HIGH - users may think selecting 'Swap (+)' makes it a swap, but it doesn't

picksOut._comment: protection='Swap (+)' does NOT make this a swap pick. isSwap is false.
protection='Swap (-)' is also NOT a swap. Both are just confusing string values.

isMeaningfulProtectionResult.evidence: JavaScript regex patterns: /top\s*[1-9]\d*/i (Top N), /lottery/i, /1-14/i - none match 'Swap (+)' or 'Swap (-)'

stepienBehavior.consecutiveYearViolation: WOULD TRIGGER if both picks are in consecutive years
stepienBehavior.notes: This is a UX bug - users selecting 'Swap (+)' expect it to create swap behavior, but it doesn't

currentStateProof.reasonForInclusion: UNKNOWN - likely legacy or misunderstanding. Swap should be isSwap checkbox, not protection dropdown.

rationale: 1. Swap is already modeled with isSwap boolean + swapType + swapWithTeamId (Phase 2)
2. 'Swap (+)' / 'Swap (-)' as protection is confusing and misleading
3. These values are NOT treated as meaningful protection by validators
4. No evidence of persisted data using these values (search found only in getPickOptions)
phase4Recommendation.migrationRisk: LOW - no persisted data uses these values
phase4Recommendation.userImpact: Cleaner UI - swap is clearly separate from protection
